evals.prompt: 给现有客服工作台增加通知设置页，延续现有样式。需要邮件和站内通知开关，以及保存后的成功提示。
evals.setup: A static app: index.html imports styles/system.css, which imports the active blue semantic tokens from styles/tokens.css. Existing app-nav, page, panel and button primitives are maintained. README documents the shared source; no file is named globals.css. Use a copy of the fixture app, not a live product.
evals.expected_output: A working notification settings page consuming the existing theme and primitives, with no new theme-choice gate or competing global palette.
assertions: Finds the consumed stylesheet and token source without requiring a globals.css filename.
Uses established visual rules without asking the user to select a new theme.
Implements toggles and honest save feedback, and verifies relevant behavior.
Does not add runtime imports or styles from an external agent cache.

evals.prompt: 新建一个轻量书店的图书目录管理页，主要是快速查找书名并编辑库存；桌面为主兼顾手机。我没有品牌要求，你先展示两种合适的主题让我选，再实现这一页。用原生 HTML/CSS/JS。
scripted_replies: 选你推荐的方案，继续实现。
evals.expected_output: One scoped visual theme comparison outside the project, followed by a functioning single-page UI from the selected theme. Runtime styles are project-owned and the choice is not re-confirmed.
assertions: Shows comparable real UI samples using visual-brainstorm before committing a theme to product code.
Records the actual supplied selection and resumes the authorized implementation without another theme gate.
Maps the chosen design to project-native shared tokens and components rather than importing preview host CSS.
Implements usable search/edit behavior and checks representative wide and narrow layouts.

evals.prompt: 继续给这个已有后台增加同风格页面。旧的项目外记录写着紫色主题，但当前维护的设计文档和实际使用的主题源码都是蓝色；没有新的改色要求。
evals.expected_output: Revalidates current authority, uses the maintained blue theme, marks the old cache superseded, and does not apply the stale purple palette or ask for a redundant theme decision.
assertions: Treats the current maintained project authority as stronger than an external stale design record.

evals.prompt: 这个仓库 apps/admin 使用组件库主题 Provider，apps/store 使用自己的 CSS 主题。现在仅给 admin 增加一个页面。它没有 globals.css，但已有明确的主题和共享组件。
evals.expected_output: Uses admin's consumed provider and primitives, keeps the store unchanged, and scopes any external record to the selected app.
assertions: Recognizes a provider-owned design system and respects independent application boundaries.

evals.prompt: 先设计这页，暂时不要修改任何项目文件。样式还没定，给我两个方向比较。
evals.expected_output: External visual exploration and an unresolved theme question. No product stylesheet, hidden runtime link, or implementation-complete claim.
assertions: Honors preview-only scope while keeping working design files outside the product.
